ns2:section.sectionText: PIR Dialogue Course. Full semester class. 2 hours (letter-graded) credit. 33901 IG0 MEN AND WOMEN DIALOGUE. Day and Time: Wednesdays, 11:00 am -12:50 pm. Starting Date: August 30 - December 6. Location: 210A Architecture Bldg. ENROLLMENT BY APPLICATION, through the Program on Intergroup Relations (PIR), 110 Turner Student Services Building, 610 E. John, Champaign. See: www.intergrouprelations.uiuc.edu for courses and enrollment information, including the application form. If you still have questions AFTER VIEWING THE WEBSITE, you can call the PIR Office at 244-3356.
